title: Dex the Little Dinosaur’s Big Day
subtitle: A Bold & Easy Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6

special.title: Dex the little dinosaur, Pip the baby pterodactyl and Rory the baby T-rex standing together happily in a jungle clearing with ferns, palm trees and a small volcano far away; keep the top third of the picture open sky with only a few simple clouds
special.belongs: Dex the little dinosaur sitting up in his cozy nest of leaves waving; keep the bottom third of the picture calm (just leaves and the nest edge) with nothing small or busy
special.end: Dex, Pip and Rory waving goodbye together in a sunny jungle clearing, waving at the viewer; keep the top third of the picture open sky with only a few simple clouds

pages.text: Dex the dinosaur wakes up. Good morning, sun!
pages.scene: sitting up in a big round nest of twigs and leaves, stretching and yawning, a big smiling sun rising behind giant ferns

pages.text: Dex stretches his little legs. Stomp, stomp!
pages.scene: standing next to his nest stretching one leg, stomping on the ground with little dust puffs, ferns around

pages.text: Mama brings yummy green leaves.
pages.scene: with Mama Triceratops (a bigger version of Dex with a flower behind her frill) who is carrying a big pile of green leaves in her mouth, by the nest

pages.text: Crunch, crunch, crunch! Dex munches his breakfast.
pages.scene: sitting happily munching a big leaf, cheeks full, leaf crumbs flying, more leaves piled beside him

pages.text: Mama gives Dex a big, warm hug.
pages.scene: being hugged by Mama Triceratops, both smiling with eyes closed, hearts floating above them

pages.text: Dex walks into the big green jungle.
pages.scene: walking down a path into a jungle with giant ferns, big leaves, palm trees and vines, looking excited

pages.text: Look! A little pterodactyl flies down.
pages.scene: looking up in surprise at Pip, a little baby pterodactyl (round head with a small crest, tiny beak, small wings), gliding down from the sky between trees

pages.text: This is Pip. Pip says hello!
pages.scene: and Pip the baby pterodactyl standing face to face on a mossy log, Pip waving one wing hello, both smiling

pages.text: Dex and Pip race to the pond.
pages.scene: running along a path while Pip flies low beside him, both looking back and laughing, a pond visible ahead

pages.text: Splash! They jump into the water.
pages.scene: and Pip jumping into a jungle pond, big water splashes, lily pads and reeds

pages.text: Dex blows big, shiny bubbles.
pages.scene: sitting in shallow pond water blowing big round bubbles, Pip laughing and popping a bubble with his wing, lily pads around

pages.text: Wow! They find a huge spotty egg.
pages.scene: and Pip standing on a sandy shore looking amazed at a huge spotted egg in a little nest of leaves

pages.text: The egg goes wobble, wobble, wobble.
pages.scene: and Pip watching wide-eyed as the big spotted egg rocks and wobbles with little motion lines around it

pages.text: Crack! A baby dino says hello.
pages.scene: and Pip watching as the egg cracks open and Rory, a tiny baby T-rex (big round head, tiny arms, small round tail, friendly smile), peeks out of the shell pieces

pages.text: This is Rory. Rory is a little shy.
pages.scene: and Pip next to Rory the baby T-rex who is shyly hiding half behind an eggshell piece, blushing, tiny arms held together

pages.text: Dex shares his leaf with Rory.
pages.scene: holding out a big green leaf to Rory the baby T-rex, Pip watching happily

pages.text: They play hide and seek in the ferns.
pages.scene: playing hide and seek among giant ferns with Pip and Rory, Rory peeking out from behind a fern, Dex covering his eyes counting

pages.text: Pip flies up to the tallest tree.
pages.scene: looking up and waving, with Rory beside him, while Pip flies up near the top of a very tall tree, a bird nest in the branches

pages.text: Dex and Rory climb a rocky hill.
pages.scene: and Rory the baby T-rex climbing up a small rocky hill together, helping each other, Pip flying above

pages.text: Look! A big, round volcano.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip standing on top of the hill looking at a big round friendly volcano far away with a small cloud of smoke, jungle below

pages.text: Puff, puff! The volcano goes rumble.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip giggling and covering their ears as the volcano in the distance puffs little round smoke clouds, rumble lines around it

pages.text: They find a shiny, sparkly rock.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip bending over a big sparkling gem-like rock with star shapes around it, all amazed

pages.text: They stack rocks into a tall tower.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip stacking round rocks into a tall wobbly tower, Pip placing the top rock while flying

pages.text: Whee! They slide down the grassy hill.
pages.scene: and Rory sliding down a grassy hill together on their bellies, arms up, laughing, Pip flying alongside

pages.text: Drip, drop! Rain clouds come.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip looking up at big fluffy rain clouds with the first raindrops falling

pages.text: Splash! They dance in the rain.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip dancing and jumping in puddles in the rain, big raindrops and splashes, big leaves as umbrellas

pages.text: A big, bright rainbow appears.
pages.scene: and Rory and Pip sitting side by side looking up at a big rainbow over the jungle, sun peeking out

pages.text: Mama calls, "Time to go home!"
pages.scene: waving goodbye to Rory and Pip while Mama Triceratops waves from the path and calls him, evening sun low over the jungle

pages.text: Goodnight, Dex. Sweet dreams!
pages.scene: fast asleep curled up in his nest hugging a soft leaf pillow, eyes closed, a smiling crescent moon and big stars in the sky, sleepy Zzz

cover.blurb:
Color and read along with Dex!

It’s a sunny morning, and Dex the little dinosaur can’t wait to explore the jungle. He meets Pip the pterodactyl, splashes in the pond, helps a giant egg hatch, spots a rumbling volcano, and dances in the rain before a cozy bedtime hug from Mama.

Every page has one short sentence in BIG, easy letters and one bold, thick-lined picture that’s easy to color. Perfect for ages 3-6.
